title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
songSummary: Practices steady beat, finding one special note, echoing short patterns, counting to three and taking turns, with a gentle tune about a lamb.

classes.title: Sway with the little lamb
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and notice that the first tune comes back again.
classes.parentTip: Sway with your child; when the first tune comes back, gasp and point: again!

classes.bridge: Each tap is one little hoof on the path: step, step, step.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat, together.

classes.title: Find the lamb's note E
classes.goal: Find the special note E by using the two black keys as a landmark.
classes.parentTip: Guide your child's finger over two black keys, then slide right to E.

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger over two black keys, then slide right to E.

classes.bridge: E is the lamb's door, just right of the two black keys.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E next to the two black keys.

classes.title: Mama sheep, baby lamb
classes.goal: Find E in a low place and a high place and hear they match.
classes.parentTip: Say "mama" in a deep voice for low E, "baby" in a tiny voice for high E.

segments.caption: Mama sheep says baa low

segments.caption: E lives up high too!

segments.caption: Baby lamb sings up high
segments.parentCue: Point right, to the high side, together

classes.childAction: Hop between low E and high E, deep voice then tiny voice.
classes.bridge: Low E is mama sheep on the left; high E is baby lamb.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same note, low and high.

classes.parentTip: Point to D or E just before it comes, then let your child press it.
